scope: Earth-like local regions, geological landforms, ground surfaces and vegetation. Animals/humans/weather/sky behaviour excluded.
status: Review in progress: candidate terrain43/Hyper38 improves two visually rejected terrain42 features. New candidate images still pending; shortcut unchanged.
limitations: 100+FPS everywhere at Medium is not achieved: tall-savanna travel remains about 92FPS and travel frame-time tails exceed 10ms.
Offscreen fixed-site benchmarks are not universal whole-game guarantees; independent GPU timing samples unavailable.
True river distributary deltas, fjords, arches, complete barrier-island systems, eruptions and caves remain unimplemented.
Landforms remain a game approximation with visible texture repetition and stylized silhouettes.
The /landmark command searches bounded generated candidates and may not find every suitable example.

native_cases.findings: Current regression: vegetation outside shelter and cleared floor remain; entrance is unobstructed and complete. Wide camp-first is obscured by a foreground crown and is not a useful showcase. Actual walking, camp cycle and current binary save/load passed.

Current cold-context regression: fitted complete hide shelters on a slope, visible entrance and bedding, no trunk intrusion. Actual entry/exit, camp cycle and binary save/load passed. Dawn lighting and a square loaded footprint make this a mechanics regression, not a finished landscape showcase.

Historical same-geometry reference: broad incised terraces and gullies with continuous rendered water. More varied than the baseline, but walls remain gamified and rhythmic and the water corridor is broad; not a complete Grand Canyon reconstruction.
